new_statement: Centered covering with the correct specialization: any map g:B_r(0)->X with g(0)=0 and ||(g(h)-g(k))-(h-k)||<=c||h-k|| for 0<=c<1 satisfies B_{(1-c)r}(0) subset g(B_r(0)).
